official.source: Georgia Department of Revenue, Important Tax Updates (2026 income tax changes)
official.quote: The Georgia income tax rate has been reduced to a flat rate of 4.99% ... The Georgia standard deduction has been increased to $15,000 for single taxpayers

official.source: Utah Code 59-10-104 as amended by S.B. 60 (2026 General Session)
official.quote: the tax is an amount equal to the product of: (a) the resident individual's state taxable income for that taxable year; and (b) 4.45%. ... retrospective operation for a taxable year beginning on or after January 1, 2026

official.source: South Carolina Department of Revenue, Information about H. 4216 (15 April 2026)
official.quote: The tax rate for income less than $30,000 is 1.99% ... The tax rate for income from $30,000 and above is 5.21%, minus $966 ... $15,000 for taxpayers who file as single
official.arithmetic: 5.21 percent of all income less USD 966 equals 1.99 percent of the first USD 30,000 (USD 597) plus 5.21 percent above it; the deduction may be reduced by income (not modeled)

official.source: West Virginia State Tax Department, Personal Income Tax Reduction (2026 SB 392, W. Va. Code 11-21-4j)
official.quote: Not over $10,000 | 2.11% of taxable income | Over $10,000 but not over $25,000 | $211.00 plus 2.81% ... Over $60,000 | $1,950.50 plus 4.58% of excess over $60,000
